#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST="backup-srv:/srv/nightly"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

rsync -av --rsync-path="mkdir -p /srv/nightly && rsync" "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied to $DEST"
